reviews.text: Tab search is already included in Chrome (Ctrl+Alt +A), so there's likely no use for this extension anymore.

I really like this extension but there is a major bug that causes me pain.

I pin tabs that I don't to get closed. And uncheck the option "include pinned tabs". But after a period of time, don't know when, it gets set back to selected. And then when I bulk close tabs, these pinned tabs get closed as well. 

And then I have to go back and uncheck in once more.
Even though Chrome has a tab switcher shortcut, this extension has far superior search making it a better option.
tags: superior search vs chrome tab switcher

reviews.text: love the keyboard shortcuts to navigate through recent tabs
Been using this for years. Highly recommended for power users with lots of open tabs and keyboard first approach. One of only two extensions I could not live without. Thanks for creating it!

The only good tab switcher (extremely lightweight on RAM), and Fuzzy search (actually good search). For anyone wondering: 
Yes, it is many times faster to open & search than native Chrome tab search.

(the native one lags on opening, lags on typing, doesn't have fuzzy search, and doesn't search inside URLs)
